reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, so this hits a real problem for me. The lab report behind the QR code and the money-back deal make $24.99 an easy yellow cart tap.
objection: It is still 2 capsules every single day, and I already forget pills. I also do not know if the lab report is for real or just a pretty page.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report did not match the batch number on the box, or if reviews said the capsules upset the stomach.
